src/troupe/cli.py:138 (diff.patch:138): set now tags include-looking values !literal by default. DECISIONS/README describe the new rule but do not say this changes how set wrote file:x values before
notes: With git blame, the commit subject and DECISIONS.md give a reason for the new features. The commit also does not point to the record.
